{{Quote|Minnisiat is the chief trade language among the various peoples of this area. Most Chiss know at least some of it, particularly those who live on border worlds like Crustai.|[[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano|Formbi]]|<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
The [[Trade language/Legends|trade language]] known as '''Minnisiat''' was a ''lingua franca'' in the space around the frontiers of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].

Minnisiat was the language which the young [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] offered to teach [[Jorj Car'das]] in lieu of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] language [[Cheunh/Legends|Cheunh]], and, five decades later, it was the language in which the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]], masquerading as peaceable [[Geroon (species)|Geroons]], opened communications with the Chiss consular ship ''[[Chaf Envoy]]''.
